recipeNotes: The stress case. Started through the pinned CLI entry with sqlite; owner setup, then the REST surface the editor itself calls (node types, credential types, workflows, executions, settings), then creating and MANUALLY EXECUTING a workflow — which is what forces the node/credential loading machinery behind n8n's 29,491 unresolved-specifier NFT warnings to actually resolve something.

phases.name: common
phases.detail: health, settings, editor bootstrap, node/credential type catalogues

phases.name: full
phases.detail: owner setup → workflow create → MANUAL EXECUTION → executions/credentials/tags surface
